scores.reason: Line 252 issues DELETE v1/containers/{id}/secrets/{secretName}; the Barbican containers reference documents only DELETE /v1/containers/{container_uuid}/secrets with a JSON body {name, secret_ref} (secret_ref required, 400 'Missing secret_ref'), and the input schema has no secret_ref. The path-segment form is undocumented so the call will fail. Moderate rather than Major because no client component calls deleteContainerSecret yet. C42 describes the same problem.
Same problem as C33 (wrong DELETE path/body for removing a container secret); verified against containers.rst.

secret_refs items use name: z.string() while the reference marks name as optional for container secret refs, and sibling name fields are nullable; an unnamed ref returning null would make parseOrThrow reject the whole container/list response. Rare in practice, hence 50.

Containers list reference documents only offset/limit, so name is likely ignored, but the client's ContainersList does not appear to send a name search, so I could not confirm any user-visible effect.
The reference restricts PUT /v1/secrets/{uuid} to payload-less secrets, but I found no client caller of updateSecret, and the failure would just surface Barbican's error; impact unclear.

orders.rst says valid types are key and asymmetric, but Barbican also supports certificate orders (documented elsewhere) and the UI deliberately offers it; the reference page alone does not show it fails.
limit: z.number().default(20) at line 21 has no max, but Barbican clamps to 100 and the UI uses 50; no concrete user-visible effect.

No KeyManager mutation checks the policy engine; permissionRouter only exposes canUser. Barbican enforces its own authorization with the user's token, and the same pattern exists in Network routers, so no concrete exploit path in this PR.
